text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (20.2%, 3.9%, 7.38, z 2.93, 28%, 19 docs, 4 supported 99215, 5 of 15). The leaning is cautious and the next steps are sensible. The structured next step lists only C0312390 and C0312405 while the rationale names different claims, and C0312405 (hyperlipidemia, one condition) is a weak example.
